title: The Stream Litter Count Made after a Strong Storm
sentences: A class counted litter beside a local stream once each month.
In June they found twenty-two pieces, but in July they counted sixty-eight.
Some students said people started dropping much more trash in July.
The teacher reminded them that a strong storm had flooded the stream two days before the July count.
The class realized that storm water possibly carried litter from other places into their study area.
They kept the July number but labeled it 'after major storm' instead of removing it.
One week later, they made an extra count under normal water conditions and found thirty-one pieces.
Their report showed all three numbers and explained why the July result should not be treated as a normal month alone.
The class learned that unusual conditions should be recorded because they can change what a comparison means.

slashRows.en: A class counted litter beside a local stream once each month.
slashRows.jp: クラスは毎月一度、地域の小川のごみを数えていました。

slashRows.en: In June they found twenty-two pieces, but in July they counted sixty-eight.
slashRows.jp: 六月は二十二個でしたが、七月には六十八個数えました。

slashRows.en: Some students said people started dropping much more trash in July.
slashRows.jp: 何人かの生徒は、七月に人々が急に多くごみを捨て始めたと言いました。

slashRows.en: The teacher reminded them that a strong storm had flooded the stream two days before the July count.
slashRows.jp: 先生は、七月の調査二日前に強い嵐で小川が増水したことを思い出させました。

slashRows.en: The class realized that storm water possibly carried litter from other places into their study area.
slashRows.jp: クラスは、嵐の水が別の場所から調査区域へごみを運んだ可能性があると気づきました。

slashRows.en: They kept the July number but labeled it 'after major storm' instead of removing it.
slashRows.jp: 七月の数字は削除せず、「大きな嵐の後」と注記しました。

slashRows.en: One week later, they made an extra count under normal water conditions and found thirty-one pieces.
slashRows.jp: 一週間後、通常の水量で追加調査すると三十一個でした。

slashRows.en: Their report showed all three numbers and explained why the July result should not be treated as a normal month alone.
slashRows.jp: 報告書には三つの数字を示し、七月だけを通常月として扱えない理由を説明しました。

slashRows.en: The class learned that unusual conditions should be recorded because they can change what a comparison means.
slashRows.jp: クラスは、異常な条件は比較の意味を変えるため記録すべきだと学びました。

title: A Garden Watering Plan during a Hot Week
sentences: The gardening club cared for vegetables during a week of unusually hot weather.
Its normal plan watered every bed lightly at four in the afternoon.
By Wednesday, leaves in the sunniest bed were drooping before lunch even though the soil had been watered the day before.
The club had a limited water supply and could not simply double the amount for every bed.
They checked the soil early in the morning and found that shaded beds were still damp while the sunny bed was dry.
They changed the plan so the sunny bed received more water early in the morning, when less water would evaporate quickly.
The shaded beds kept their smaller amount and were checked before any extra watering.
By Friday, the sunny plants were less wilted and the club had stayed within its weekly water limit.
The club learned to match a hot-weather plan to each bed.

slashRows.en: The gardening club cared for vegetables during a week of unusually hot weather.
slashRows.jp: 園芸部は非常に暑い一週間、野菜の世話をしました。

slashRows.en: Its normal plan watered every bed lightly at four in the afternoon.
slashRows.jp: 通常は午後四時にすべての畑へ少量ずつ水をやっていました。

slashRows.en: By Wednesday, leaves in the sunniest bed were drooping before lunch even though the soil had been watered the day before.
slashRows.jp: 水をやった翌日でも、水曜には最も日当たりのよい畑の葉が昼前にしおれていました。

slashRows.en: The club had a limited water supply and could not simply double the amount for every bed.
slashRows.jp: 使える水に限りがあり、すべての畑の量を単純に二倍にはできませんでした。

slashRows.en: They checked the soil early in the morning and found that shaded beds were still damp while the sunny bed was dry.
slashRows.jp: 朝早く土を調べると、日陰の畑はまだ湿っていましたが日なたは乾いていました。

slashRows.en: They changed the plan so the sunny bed received more water early in the morning, when less water would evaporate quickly.
slashRows.jp: 日なたの畑には蒸発しにくい朝早くに多めの水をやるよう変更しました。

slashRows.en: The shaded beds kept their smaller amount and were checked before any extra watering.
slashRows.jp: 日陰の畑は少なめの量を続け、追加前に土を確認しました。

slashRows.en: By Friday, the sunny plants were less wilted and the club had stayed within its weekly water limit.
slashRows.jp: 金曜までに日なたの植物はしおれにくくなり、週の水使用量も上限内でした。

slashRows.en: The club learned to match a hot-weather plan to each bed.
slashRows.jp: 園芸部は、暑い時期の計画を各畑の条件に合わせると学びました。

title: The Library Shelf Display That Changed What Students Borrowed
sentences: The library placed six nature books on a bright display near the entrance for one month.
Those books were borrowed much more often than they had been during the previous month.
A student wrote that the display proved everyone had suddenly become more interested in nature.
The librarian pointed out that the books had also become easier to see and reach.
The committee realized that borrowing numbers alone could not show whether interest or visibility caused the change.
The next month, they displayed six history books in the same place and recorded their borrowing too.
History borrowing also rose, although not by exactly the same amount.
The final report said displays appeared to influence borrowing but did not claim they changed students' long-term interests.
The committee learned to separate what a pattern suggests from what the available evidence can actually prove.

slashRows.en: The library placed six nature books on a bright display near the entrance for one month.
slashRows.jp: 図書館は一か月、入口近くの目立つ展示に自然の本六冊を置きました。

slashRows.en: Those books were borrowed much more often than they had been during the previous month.
slashRows.jp: その本は前月よりずっと多く借りられました。

slashRows.en: A student wrote that the display proved everyone had suddenly become more interested in nature.
slashRows.jp: ある生徒は、みんなが急に自然へ関心を持った証拠だと書きました。

slashRows.en: The librarian pointed out that the books had also become easier to see and reach.
slashRows.jp: 司書は、本が以前より見つけやすく手に取りやすくなったことも指摘しました。

slashRows.en: The committee realized that borrowing numbers alone could not show whether interest or visibility caused the change.
slashRows.jp: 委員会は、貸出数だけでは興味と見やすさのどちらが変化の原因か分からないと気づきました。

slashRows.en: The next month, they displayed six history books in the same place and recorded their borrowing too.
slashRows.jp: 翌月、同じ場所に歴史の本六冊を展示し、貸出数を記録しました。

slashRows.en: History borrowing also rose, although not by exactly the same amount.
slashRows.jp: 歴史の本の貸出も増えましたが、増え方は同じではありませんでした。

slashRows.en: The final report said displays appeared to influence borrowing but did not claim they changed students' long-term interests.
slashRows.jp: 最終報告は展示が貸出に影響するようだと述べましたが、長期的な興味まで変えたとは主張しませんでした。

slashRows.en: The committee learned to separate what a pattern suggests from what the available evidence can actually prove.
slashRows.jp: 委員会は、傾向が示すことと証拠で実際に証明できることを分けると学びました。

title: A Limited Repair Budget for Sports Equipment
sentences: The sports committee had money for repairs to only three of five damaged items.
The list included two volleyball nets, a ball cart, a bench, and a scoreboard stand.
At first, students wanted to repair three items with high club use.
The PE teacher said they also needed a record of safety risk and frequency of use.
One bench had a sharp broken edge, while one net was old but could still be used safely for practice.
The committee ranked each item by safety, whether another item could replace it, and repair cost.
They repaired the bench, the unstable scoreboard stand, and the ball cart first.
They marked the damaged nets for limited use and requested money for them in the next budget.
The committee learned that limited money should be used first where delay creates the greatest practical risk.

slashRows.en: The sports committee had money for repairs to only three of five damaged items.
slashRows.jp: 体育委員会には、壊れた五つの物のうち三つだけを修理できる予算がありました。

slashRows.en: The list included two volleyball nets, a ball cart, a bench, and a scoreboard stand.
slashRows.jp: 一覧にはバレーボールネット二つ、ボール用台車、ベンチ、得点板の台がありました。

slashRows.en: At first, students wanted to repair three items with high club use.
slashRows.jp: 最初、生徒たちは多くの部が使う三つの物を修理したいと考えました。

slashRows.en: The PE teacher said they also needed a record of safety risk and frequency of use.
slashRows.jp: 体育の先生は、使用頻度だけでなく安全上の危険も記録する必要があると言いました。

slashRows.en: One bench had a sharp broken edge, while one net was old but could still be used safely for practice.
slashRows.jp: 一つのベンチには鋭く壊れた部分があり、一つのネットは古くても練習には安全に使えました。

slashRows.en: The committee ranked each item by safety, whether another item could replace it, and repair cost.
slashRows.jp: 委員会は安全性、代用品の有無、修理費で各用具を順位付けしました。

slashRows.en: They repaired the bench, the unstable scoreboard stand, and the ball cart first.
slashRows.jp: まずベンチ、不安定な得点板の台、ボール用台車を修理しました。

slashRows.en: They marked the damaged nets for limited use and requested money for them in the next budget.
slashRows.jp: 傷んだネットは使用を限定し、次の予算で修理費を申請しました。

slashRows.en: The committee learned that limited money should be used first where delay creates the greatest practical risk.
slashRows.jp: 委員会は、限られた予算は修理を遅らせる実際の危険が大きい所から使うべきだと学びました。

title: The Animal Shelter Visit with Three Volunteer Jobs
sentences: A class planned to volunteer for two hours at a local animal shelter.
The shelter offered three jobs: washing bowls, preparing food, and walking calm adult dogs.
Several students immediately chose dog walking because it sounded the most enjoyable.
The staff explained that walkers needed a full hour, closed shoes, and confidence holding a lead.
Two students had to leave early for a bus, and one student was uncomfortable around large dogs.
The class matched jobs to available time and comfort instead of treating one task as the best volunteer work.
Students leaving early washed bowls, the student uneasy with dogs prepared food, and trained groups walked the dogs.
All three jobs were finished before the visit ended, and nobody had to take a role that felt unsafe.
The class learned that useful volunteering depends on what an organization needs and what each person can safely do.

slashRows.en: A class planned to volunteer for two hours at a local animal shelter.
slashRows.jp: クラスは地域の動物保護施設で二時間ボランティアをする計画を立てました。

slashRows.en: The shelter offered three jobs: washing bowls, preparing food, and walking calm adult dogs.
slashRows.jp: 施設には食器洗い、餌の準備、おとなしい成犬の散歩という三つの仕事がありました。

slashRows.en: Several students immediately chose dog walking because it sounded the most enjoyable.
slashRows.jp: 何人かの生徒は一番楽しそうだという理由ですぐ犬の散歩を選びました。

slashRows.en: The staff explained that walkers needed a full hour, closed shoes, and confidence holding a lead.
slashRows.jp: 職員は、散歩担当には一時間、つま先の閉じた靴、リードを持つ自信が必要だと説明しました。

slashRows.en: Two students had to leave early for a bus, and one student was uncomfortable around large dogs.
slashRows.jp: 二人はバスのため早く帰る必要があり、一人は大きな犬が苦手でした。

slashRows.en: The class matched jobs to available time and comfort instead of treating one task as the best volunteer work.
slashRows.jp: クラスは一つの仕事を最良とせず、使える時間と得意不得意に仕事を合わせました。

slashRows.en: Students leaving early washed bowls, the student uneasy with dogs prepared food, and trained groups walked the dogs.
slashRows.jp: 早く帰る生徒は食器洗い、犬が苦手な生徒は餌準備、説明を受けた班は散歩を担当しました。

slashRows.en: All three jobs were finished before the visit ended, and nobody had to take a role that felt unsafe.
slashRows.jp: 訪問終了までに三つの仕事が終わり、危険に感じる役割を無理にする人はいませんでした。

slashRows.en: The class learned that useful volunteering depends on what an organization needs and what each person can safely do.
slashRows.jp: クラスは、役立つボランティアは施設の必要と各人が安全にできることの両方で決まると学びました。

title: A Winter Walking Route That Became Dark before Club Ended
sentences: In September, the basketball club walked from school to a nearby station after practice.
The usual route passed a riverside path that was quiet and pleasant in daylight.
By November, practice still ended at five thirty, but the riverside path was already dark.
One student nearly missed a low step; only a few lights were near that section.
The club realized that a route safe in early autumn was not automatically safe under winter light conditions.
They compared a slightly longer main-road route that had sidewalks, shops, and streetlights.
For winter practices, the team used the main road and asked students not to walk alone after the group separated.
They planned to review the riverside route again when practice ended in daylight in spring.
The club learned that route safety can change with season and time even when the road itself has not changed.

slashRows.en: In September, the basketball club walked from school to a nearby station after practice.
slashRows.jp: 九月、バスケットボール部は練習後に学校から近くの駅まで歩いていました。

slashRows.en: The usual route passed a riverside path that was quiet and pleasant in daylight.
slashRows.jp: いつもの道は昼間なら静かで気持ちのよい川沿いの道を通っていました。

slashRows.en: By November, practice still ended at five thirty, but the riverside path was already dark.
slashRows.jp: 十一月になると練習終了は五時半のままでも、川沿いはすでに暗くなっていました。

slashRows.en: One student nearly missed a low step; only a few lights were near that section.
slashRows.jp: 一人の生徒は低い段差を見落としかけました。その場所の近くには照明が少ししかありませんでした。

slashRows.en: The club realized that a route safe in early autumn was not automatically safe under winter light conditions.
slashRows.jp: 部は、初秋に安全な道でも冬の明るさでは同じとは限らないと気づきました。

slashRows.en: They compared a slightly longer main-road route that had sidewalks, shops, and streetlights.
slashRows.jp: 少し長いものの、歩道、店、街灯がある大通りの道と比べました。

slashRows.en: For winter practices, the team used the main road and asked students not to walk alone after the group separated.
slashRows.jp: 冬の練習後は大通りを使い、集団から分かれた後も一人で歩かないようにしました。

slashRows.en: They planned to review the riverside route again when practice ended in daylight in spring.
slashRows.jp: 春に練習後も明るくなったら川沿いの道を再確認することにしました。

slashRows.en: The club learned that route safety can change with season and time even when the road itself has not changed.
slashRows.jp: 部は、道路自体が変わらなくても季節と時刻で道の安全性は変わると学びました。

title: The Recycled Paper Notebook That Tore at the Binding
sentences: An environment club tested notebooks made from recycled paper for next year's school store.
The paper wrote smoothly, and students liked the simple cover design.
After two weeks, however, several pages began tearing close to the metal binding.
At first, the club thought the recycled paper itself was too weak.
They compared unused sheets and found that the paper away from the holes did not tear easily.
The holes had been punched very close to the edge, leaving only a narrow strip of paper around the binding.
The maker produced a small trial with the holes moved farther inward and a slightly wider inner margin.
After another two-week test, the same paper stayed attached much better.
The club learned to locate the failure point before blaming an entire material for a product problem.

slashRows.en: An environment club tested notebooks made from recycled paper for next year's school store.
slashRows.jp: 環境部は翌年の学校売店用に再生紙ノートを試しました。

slashRows.en: The paper wrote smoothly, and students liked the simple cover design.
slashRows.jp: 紙は書きやすく、生徒たちは簡単な表紙デザインも気に入りました。

slashRows.en: After two weeks, however, several pages began tearing close to the metal binding.
slashRows.jp: しかし二週間後、何枚かのページが金属のとじ部分近くで破れ始めました。

slashRows.en: At first, the club thought the recycled paper itself was too weak.
slashRows.jp: 最初、部は再生紙そのものが弱すぎると思いました。

slashRows.en: They compared unused sheets and found that the paper away from the holes did not tear easily.
slashRows.jp: 未使用の紙と比べると、穴から離れた部分は簡単には破れませんでした。

slashRows.en: The holes had been punched very close to the edge, leaving only a narrow strip of paper around the binding.
slashRows.jp: 穴が端に近すぎ、金属の周りに細い紙しか残っていませんでした。

slashRows.en: The maker produced a small trial with the holes moved farther inward and a slightly wider inner margin.
slashRows.jp: 製造者は穴を少し内側へ移し、内側余白を広くした試作品を作りました。

slashRows.en: After another two-week test, the same paper stayed attached much better.
slashRows.jp: もう二週間試すと、同じ紙でもかなり外れにくくなりました。

slashRows.en: The club learned to locate the failure point before blaming an entire material for a product problem.
slashRows.jp: 環境部は、製品の問題を素材全体のせいにする前に壊れた場所を特定すべきだと学びました。

title: A Music Rehearsal Changed after the Sound Echoed from the Wall
sentences: The school band moved its rehearsal to a wide hall while the music room was repaired.
Players near the back wall heard repeated sounds and had trouble following the conductor's beat.
The band first played more loudly, but the echo became stronger instead of clearer.
The teacher asked groups to stop and listen from different positions in the hall.
They found that the strongest echo occurred where brass instruments faced the hard back wall directly.
The band turned the brass section slightly inward and moved two rows farther from the wall.
They also placed thick stage curtains behind the section where possible.
A second rehearsal sounded clearer, and players could follow the beat without increasing volume.
The band learned that changing position and surfaces can solve an acoustic problem, while louder playing can worsen the problem.

slashRows.en: The school band moved its rehearsal to a wide hall while the music room was repaired.
slashRows.jp: 音楽室の修理中、吹奏楽部は広いホールへ練習場所を移しました。

slashRows.en: Players near the back wall heard repeated sounds and had trouble following the conductor's beat.
slashRows.jp: 後ろの壁近くの演奏者は音が反響し、指揮の拍を追いにくく感じました。

slashRows.en: The band first played more loudly, but the echo became stronger instead of clearer.
slashRows.jp: 最初はより大きな音で演奏しましたが、明瞭になるどころか反響が強くなりました。

slashRows.en: The teacher asked groups to stop and listen from different positions in the hall.
slashRows.jp: 先生は演奏を止め、ホールの別々の位置で音を聞くよう求めました。

slashRows.en: They found that the strongest echo occurred where brass instruments faced the hard back wall directly.
slashRows.jp: 金管楽器が硬い後ろ壁へ直接向く場所で反響が最も強いと分かりました。

slashRows.en: The band turned the brass section slightly inward and moved two rows farther from the wall.
slashRows.jp: 金管楽器を少し内側へ向け、二列を壁から離しました。

slashRows.en: They also placed thick stage curtains behind the section where possible.
slashRows.jp: 可能な場所にはその後ろへ厚い舞台カーテンも置きました。

slashRows.en: A second rehearsal sounded clearer, and players could follow the beat without increasing volume.
slashRows.jp: 二回目の練習では音が明瞭になり、音量を上げずに拍を追えました。

slashRows.en: The band learned that changing position and surfaces can solve an acoustic problem, while louder playing can worsen the problem.
slashRows.jp: 楽団は、位置や周囲の面を変えることで音響の問題を改善でき、大きく演奏するだけではその問題を悪化させることもあると学びました。

title: The Curtain Trial for a Classroom That Became Too Warm
sentences: A south-facing classroom became very warm during sunny afternoons in early summer.
Students suggested keeping all curtains closed from morning until school ended.
The teacher said, “Compare temperature and light before making a permanent rule.”
For three days, they closed the sunniest windows after lunch and left the other curtains open.
The afternoon temperature fell a little, and students could still read without turning on every light.
On a cloudy day, closing the same curtains made the room darker but did not reduce heat in a useful way.
The class changed its plan to use the curtains only when direct sun reached the desks.
They kept ventilation and the school's heat-safety rules as separate requirements.
The students learned that a simple shade measure can help under the right condition without becoming an all-day rule.

slashRows.en: A south-facing classroom became very warm during sunny afternoons in early summer.
slashRows.jp: 南向きの教室は初夏の晴れた午後、とても暑くなりました。

slashRows.en: Students suggested keeping all curtains closed from morning until school ended.
slashRows.jp: 生徒たちは朝から下校までカーテンを全部閉める案を出しました。

slashRows.en: The teacher said, “Compare temperature and light before making a permanent rule.”
slashRows.jp: 先生は「恒久的な決まりを作る前に、温度と光を比べてください」と言いました。

slashRows.en: For three days, they closed the sunniest windows after lunch and left the other curtains open.
slashRows.jp: 三日間、昼食後に最も日が当たる窓だけカーテンを閉め、ほかは開けました。

slashRows.en: The afternoon temperature fell a little, and students could still read without turning on every light.
slashRows.jp: 午後の温度は少し下がり、すべての照明を点けなくても読書できました。

slashRows.en: On a cloudy day, closing the same curtains made the room darker but did not reduce heat in a useful way.
slashRows.jp: 曇りの日に同じカーテンを閉めると、部屋は暗くなりましたが有効な温度低下はありませんでした。

slashRows.en: The class changed its plan to use the curtains only when direct sun reached the desks.
slashRows.jp: クラスは、直射日光が机へ届くときだけカーテンを使うことにしました。

slashRows.en: They kept ventilation and the school's heat-safety rules as separate requirements.
slashRows.jp: 換気と学校の暑さ対策規則は別の必要条件として続けました。

slashRows.en: The students learned that a simple shade measure can help under the right condition without becoming an all-day rule.
slashRows.jp: 生徒たちは、簡単な日よけも適切な条件では役立つが一日中の規則にする必要はないと学びました。

title: A Charity Sale with Too Many Unsold Small Items
sentences: A class held a charity sale with handmade bookmarks, cards, and small cloth bags.
At the end of the first day, most bags had sold, but many bookmarks and cards remained.
Some students wanted to cut every price in half the next morning.
The sales record showed that the bags were already selling well at their original price.
The class realized that lowering every price would reduce income without addressing which items were actually unsold.
They made a small set combining one bookmark and one card at a modest discount.
They kept the bag price unchanged and moved the sets beside the payment table where visitors could see them.
More small items sold on the second day, while the popular bags still brought in their full price.
The class learned that a sales change should respond to the specific pattern instead of changing successful items too.

slashRows.en: A class held a charity sale with handmade bookmarks, cards, and small cloth bags.
slashRows.jp: クラスは手作りのしおり、カード、小さな布袋で慈善販売を行いました。

slashRows.en: At the end of the first day, most bags had sold, but many bookmarks and cards remained.
slashRows.jp: 初日終了時、袋はほとんど売れましたが、しおりとカードは多く残りました。

slashRows.en: Some students wanted to cut every price in half the next morning.
slashRows.jp: 何人かは翌朝すべての値段を半額にしようとしました。

slashRows.en: The sales record showed that the bags were already selling well at their original price.
slashRows.jp: 販売記録では、袋は元の値段ですでによく売れていました。

slashRows.en: The class realized that lowering every price would reduce income without addressing which items were actually unsold.
slashRows.jp: 全商品を値下げすると、実際に売れていない商品を区別せず収入を減らすと気づきました。

slashRows.en: They made a small set combining one bookmark and one card at a modest discount.
slashRows.jp: しおり一枚とカード一枚を少し割引した小さなセットを作りました。

slashRows.en: They kept the bag price unchanged and moved the sets beside the payment table where visitors could see them.
slashRows.jp: 袋の値段は変えず、セットを来客が見やすい会計台の横へ移しました。

slashRows.en: More small items sold on the second day, while the popular bags still brought in their full price.
slashRows.jp: 二日目は小物がより多く売れ、人気の袋は定価の収入を保ちました。

slashRows.en: The class learned that a sales change should respond to the specific pattern instead of changing successful items too.
slashRows.jp: クラスは、販売方法の変更はうまくいっている商品まで変えず、具体的な売れ方に対応すべきだと学びました。
